fusions.name: Stooping Landfall
fusions.desc: You stoop onto a target up to 7 tiles away and land with the weight of stone, dealing 14 damage to every enemy within 2.5 tiles.

fusions.name: Geode Clutch
fusions.desc: Throws a stone egg that deals 8 damage to the first enemy it meets and bursts over every enemy within 2 tiles for 50% as much. You hold 3; each kill gives one back.

fusions.name: Crag Perch
fusions.desc: You hop 2 tiles onto a perch of stone, and your armour rises by 20% for 10 seconds.

fusions.name: Ballast
fusions.desc: Every few paces you cover, you gain a shield of packed grit worth 12% of your maximum health for 5 seconds. Once every 12 seconds.
